changelog: Phase L100.4 — labelled CTA + tile rhythm polish в minimal view. Главный gap: buy button был tiny circular '+' (default e-commerce icon), читалось как weak afterthought рядом с photo. Заменил на textual label 'В корзину' (universal Russian e-commerce idiom). CSS: chip min-width 96px, font-size 12px, letter-spacing 0.02em, white-space nowrap; mobile (<=480px) — min-width auto, font-size 11px. Также: image-wrap background #f4f3f0 (chalky) → pure #ffffff (cleaner blend с tile), tile-body padding 16/16/18 → 14/14/16 (more breathing), gap 12 → 14px. Modal close button: dark filled → brand accent filled (matches buy CTA visual language). CSS + 1 markup edit (menu-content-minimal.php buy-text content).
